faq.title: FAQ
faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Choosing a studio is an expensive decision to undo. Below are the questions people ask us before signing, answered the way we'd answer them on a call.

price.question: What does a project cost?
price.answer: It depends on scope, and you get the number on the first call. A full identity isn't a landing page. We work to a fixed project price: you know what it costs before we start, not after.

time.question: How long does it take?
time.answer: A site, four to eight weeks. An identity, six to ten. The variable is rarely us: it's how long content takes to arrive and answers take to come back.

remote.question: Do you work with brands outside Mexico?
remote.answer: Yes, and most of it ships remotely. From Mexico City the day overlaps with all of the Americas and reaches the European morning.

ownership.question: Who owns what you make?
ownership.answer: You do. When the project closes you get the editable files and the accounts, with no licences that expire and nothing left sitting on a server of ours.

scope.question: Can I hire just one part?
scope.answer: Yes, knowing what you give up: the site, the campaign and the motion are designed together so they say the same thing. Separately it works; together it works better.

start.question: What do you need from me to start?
start.answer: Half an hour to understand the business, someone who can say yes or no without asking four people, and whatever you already have — even if it's a logo inside a PDF.

branding.title: Branding and design
branding.description: Strategy, identity, packaging, editorial design and signage for brands that have something to say.

hero.title: Brands with something to say. Designs that leave a mark.

paragraphs: We create identities, build concepts and turn ideas into visual experiences that connect.
From the strategy behind a brand to the last detail of its execution, we develop creative solutions that combine intention, aesthetics and functionality.
Because a great brand isn't just recognized. It's remembered.

offer.label: 01. What we do
offer.title: Every detail builds a brand.
paragraphs: A brand is much more than a logo. It's a story, a personality and a visual universe that comes to life at every touchpoint.
At Pigmento we combine strategy, creativity and design to build brands from scratch, transform existing identities and create the pieces they need to grow.
Every project is different. That's why our services can be developed independently or combined to build a complete brand experience.

items.name: Brand strategy
items.title: Great brands start with a clear idea.
paragraphs: Before designing, we seek to understand. We research the market, uncover opportunities and build the foundations that give every brand direction, personality and purpose.

items.name: Brand identity
items.title: We design identities that speak for themselves.
paragraphs: We create visual universes that express the essence of each brand. Identities with personality, consistency and the ability to adapt to different formats, spaces and experiences.
From a brand about to be born to one looking to reinvent itself, we develop visual systems built to evolve.

items.name: Packaging design
items.title: Design is something you experience, too.
paragraphs: Packaging is much more than a product's presentation. It's a chance to communicate, spark interest and create a connection from the very first encounter.
We design packaging that balances aesthetics, functionality and strategy, turning products into experiences that stand out in and beyond the point of sale.
services: Box and packaging design for e-commerce

items.name: Graphic and editorial design
items.title: Ideas that take shape.
paragraphs: We turn information, concepts and messages into visual pieces that communicate with clarity and personality.
From corporate materials to editorial publications, we care for every composition, typeface and detail to create designs that reflect each brand's character.

items.name: Space and signage design
items.title: Brands are lived, too.
paragraphs: We take visual identity beyond screens and traditional formats to turn physical spaces into brand experiences.
We design graphic elements that guide, communicate and create a visual connection between people and their surroundings.
services: Graphics for offices and corporate spaces

items.name: Brand applications
items.title: One identity. Endless possibilities.
paragraphs: A brand grows stronger when it keeps its essence in every expression.
We develop applications that carry your identity across different formats, materials and experiences, keeping visual consistency without losing creativity.

closing.title: Can't find exactly what you need?
closing.text: Tell us your idea. We can develop design solutions tailored to your project.

philosophy.label: 02. Our philosophy
philosophy.title: More than designing, we get involved.
paragraphs: We believe the best ideas are born from understanding what's behind every project.
That's why, before creating, we listen. We get close to each brand to learn its story, understand its goals and discover what makes it different.
We like to question, explore and find new ways to communicate. We combine strategic thinking with creative sensitivity to develop solutions that don't just look good, but make sense.
We work closely with our clients, becoming creative allies at every stage of the process.
philosophy.tagline: Strategy that gives direction. Creativity that transforms. Design that connects.

process.label: 03. Our process
process.title: From first ideas to great results.
paragraphs: Every project has its own story, but they all share something: a creative process where strategy, collaboration and attention to detail make the difference.
Our methodology lets us turn needs into visual solutions, keeping close communication and a clear direction from start to finish.

phases.name: Discover
phases.title: It all starts with a conversation.
paragraphs: We dive into your project to learn about your business, understand your goals and uncover what you need to communicate.
We analyze the context, references and opportunities to build a solid starting point.
phases.result: A shared vision of the project's goals, needs and scope.

phases.name: Define
phases.title: We find the right direction.
paragraphs: We turn what we've learned into a conceptual and creative proposal that gives meaning to the project's development.
We establish the strategic and visual criteria that will guide our design decisions.
phases.result: A creative direction aligned with your brand's goals.

phases.name: Create
phases.title: Ideas begin to take shape.
paragraphs: Our team explores concepts, develops proposals and turns strategy into visual solutions.
Every element is designed with intention, balancing creativity, functionality and personality.
phases.result: Design proposals that respond to the project's needs.

phases.name: Refine
phases.title: Details make the difference.
paragraphs: We present our proposals, listen to your feedback and work on the adjustments needed to perfect the result.
We make sure every visual decision stays consistent with the concept and the goals we set.
phases.result: A final proposal polished down to the last detail.

phases.name: Deliver
phases.title: Ready to go out into the world.
paragraphs: We prepare and organize the final materials so every design can be implemented properly.
Depending on the service, we deliver the corresponding files, applications and guidelines, supporting you through the close of the project.
phases.result: Creative solutions ready to come to life.

process.note: Every project is unique. Timelines, stages and deliverables adapt to the scope and needs of each service.

featured.label: 04. Featured projects
featured.title: Ideas that became brands.
paragraphs: Every project is an opportunity to explore new perspectives, solve challenges and create something different.
Meet some of the brands we've worked with and see how we turn concepts into identities and visual experiences.

faq.label: 05. Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Before we begin, let's answer your questions.
paragraphs: We know every project is different and that taking the first step can raise questions. Here you'll find some answers about our services, processes and way of working.

items.question: Can I hire a design service without developing my whole brand identity?
items.answer:
Of course! You don't need a full branding project to work with us.

We can help with specific services such as packaging design, catalogs, presentations, signage, graphic materials or any other application your brand needs.

Each service is quoted independently based on its characteristics and scope.

items.question: What's the difference between branding and visual identity?
items.answer:
Branding is the strategic process of building a brand, defining its positioning, personality, values and the way it connects with its audience.

Visual identity is the graphic expression of that strategy, including elements such as the logo, typefaces, colors and visual systems.

Both work together to build brands that are coherent, recognizable and relevant.

items.question: Can you work with a brand that already has an identity?
items.answer:
Yes. We can develop new applications that respect your current identity or help you evolve it.

Depending on your business needs, we can do anything from specific adjustments to a complete brand redesign.

Our goal is to keep what makes your identity valuable and strengthen what needs to evolve.

items.question: What if I'm still not sure which service I need?
items.answer:
Don't worry. Part of our job is helping you identify the best solution for your project.

During our first conversation we'll learn about your needs, goals and ideas so we can recommend the services that truly add value to your brand.

items.question: How much does a branding or design project cost?
items.answer:
Every project has different needs, so our quotes are developed on a custom basis.

The cost depends on the type of service, the complexity, the number of applications and the deliverables required.

Before we start, you'll receive a commercial proposal with the scope, investment and terms of the project.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer:
Timelines vary depending on the service and its complexity.

A full identity project can take roughly six to ten weeks, while specific design services may require different timeframes.

At the start, we set up a work calendar with the stages and estimated delivery dates.

items.question: How many design proposals do you present?
items.answer:
The number of proposals depends on the service and the scope contracted.

Our methodology prioritizes developing well-grounded concepts, so each proposal responds to a strategic and creative direction defined beforehand.

The number of proposals is set from the start in the quote.

items.question: How many rounds of changes are included?
items.answer:
Each project includes a set number of revision rounds, specified in the commercial proposal.

During these stages we work with you to refine the design and make sure the result is aligned with the goals we set.

items.question: What files will I receive when my project is finished?
items.answer:
You'll receive the final materials for the service you contracted, prepared for proper implementation.

Depending on the project, these may include editable files, print-ready formats, digital assets, graphic applications and identity manuals.

The specific deliverables are detailed in the commercial proposal.

items.question: Do you also handle printing or production?
items.answer:
We can support you through the production process, preparing the necessary files and coordinating technical aspects with suppliers when the project requires it.

Printing, manufacturing and installation costs are quoted separately, unless they are expressly included in the proposal.

items.question: Can you develop different services for my brand?
items.answer:
Absolutely. At Pigmento we have a multidisciplinary team that lets us support brands at different stages of their growth.

Beyond branding and design, we develop digital marketing, web development and motion graphics projects.

This allows us to create integrated solutions and keep visual communication consistent across different platforms and touchpoints.

items.question: Do you work with clients outside Mexico City?
items.answer:
Yes. Although our studio is based in Mexico City, we collaborate with brands and companies from different cities and countries.

Our methodology lets us develop projects remotely, keeping close communication and constant follow-up throughout the process.

cta.label: 06. Let's start a project
cta.title: Great ideas start with a conversation.
paragraphs: Are you creating a new brand? Looking to transform your identity? Need to develop a design piece?
It doesn't matter what stage your project is in. We'd love to hear your idea, understand what you need and discover everything we can create together.
Tell us what you have in mind. We'll help you give it shape.
cta.topic: How can we help? Select the service that best describes your project

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Brand animation, video and interface motion, made by the same team that designs the identity.

items.name: Motion Branding
paragraphs: We create visual systems in motion that amplify brand identity. From logo animation to dynamic graphic universes, we design pieces that build recognition, consistency and differentiation at every digital touchpoint.

items.name: Strategic Motion Graphics
paragraphs: We turn concepts into visual pieces that communicate with clarity and precision. Explainer animations and content for campaigns, launches and social media, designed to capture attention, stay memorable and elevate brand perception.

items.name: Experiences in Motion
paragraphs: We bring together narrative, design and rhythm to build memorable experiences. Corporate videos, reels, event visuals and digital content that doesn't just look good but drives positioning and measurable results.

process.label: The process
process.title: From idea to final piece
paragraphs: Each phase is approved before the next one starts, so changes come while they are still cheap.

phases.name: Script
paragraphs: We decide what has to happen in the first few seconds and what the viewer takes away.

phases.name: Storyboard
paragraphs: Frame by frame, before animating anything. This is when changing something costs little.

phases.name: Animation
paragraphs: Movement, rhythm and sound on top of the style you already approved.

phases.name: Delivery
paragraphs: We export each piece in the format and size of the channel where it will live.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Questions
paragraphs: What is worth knowing before ordering an animated piece.

items.question: How much does a piece cost?
items.answer: Three things drive it: how long it runs, how complex the style is and how many formats it ships in. With the script in hand we give you a fixed budget.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: It depends on length and style. The delivery date is agreed before we start, together with the script.

items.question: What kind of pieces do you make?
items.answer: Animated logos, the motion of an identity, social pieces, event video and interface animation for sites and products.

items.question: Can you work on a brand you didn't design?
items.answer: Yes. We start from your guidelines and, if something is missing, we define how the brand moves before animating the first piece.

cta.title: Tell us what piece you need and when.

ways.label: 04. How we work

items.title: Teamwork

faq.label: 06. Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Everything you need to know before getting started.
paragraphs: We know choosing a marketing agency is an important decision. Here we answer some of the most frequently asked questions about our services and how we work.

items.question: What digital marketing services can I hire?
items.answer:
At Pigmento we offer digital strategy, social media management, advertising, content creation, influencer marketing, email marketing, SEO, automation and e-commerce marketing services.

You can hire specific services or develop a comprehensive strategy that combines different solutions.

items.question: Do I need to hire all the marketing services?
items.answer:
No. Every business has different goals and needs.

We can work on a comprehensive strategy or focus on specific services, such as social media management, advertising campaigns or content production.

During our first conversation we'll help you identify which solutions make the most sense for your brand.

items.question: How do I know what strategy my business needs?
items.answer:
We start by analyzing your business, your goals and your current digital presence.

From there, we identify opportunities and recommend the channels and actions that can help you reach your goals.

We don't believe in one-size-fits-all strategies. Every brand needs its own path.

items.question: How much do digital marketing services cost?
items.answer:
Our services are quoted according to the scope, channels, complexity and needs of each project.

We offer different ways of working, from specific services to monthly marketing strategies.

Before we start, you'll receive a custom proposal with the services included and the corresponding investment.

items.question: Is there a minimum contract period?
items.answer:
For ongoing digital marketing services, such as social media management and advertising campaigns, we generally work with a minimum period of three months.

This time allows us to implement the strategy, gather data and make optimizations.

Specific projects may have different terms and timelines.

items.question: How soon will I start seeing results?
items.answer:
Results depend on factors such as goals, industry, budget, competition and the channels used.

Some campaigns can generate activity within their first weeks, while positioning, brand awareness or organic growth strategies take more time.

Our approach is to set realistic goals, measure performance and optimize continuously.

items.question: Do you guarantee a specific number of sales or customers?
items.answer:
It's not possible to guarantee specific business results, since they depend on multiple factors, including the market, the offer, the budget and each business's sales process.

What we do is develop well-grounded strategies, set clear indicators and work constantly to improve the performance of the actions we implement.

items.question: Is the ad spend included in your fees?
items.answer:
No. The budget allocated to advertising platforms, such as Meta, Google or TikTok, is handled separately from our management fees.

This gives you greater transparency about how much goes directly into advertising and how much corresponds to strategy, implementation and optimization services.

items.question: What is the recommended budget for digital advertising?
items.answer:
The ideal investment depends on business goals, the market, the competition and the results you want to achieve.

We analyze each project to recommend a budget aligned with its needs and possibilities.

Our goal is to build a strategy that makes the most efficient use of the resources available.

items.question: What does the social media management service include?
items.answer:
Depending on the plan you choose, it can include content strategy, monthly planning, creative direction, post design, reels creation, copywriting, content scheduling and performance reports.

On-location photo and video production, creator collaborations and other additional services are considered according to the scope of each proposal.

items.question: Do you also respond to messages and comments on social media?
items.answer:
Our standard social media management service focuses on strategy, creation, planning and publishing of content.

Handling messages, comments and customer inquiries is not included in the standard service.

We can help you explore automation solutions that make some of these processes easier.

items.question: Do I need to provide the photos and videos?
items.answer:
It depends on the project.

We can work with your brand's existing materials or develop a content production proposal that includes photography, video and creative direction.

We can also integrate content from creators or AI tools when it suits the strategy.

items.question: Do you work with influencers and content creators?
items.answer:
Yes. We develop collaboration strategies with content creators, including profile research, concept development, deliverable coordination and campaign tracking.

Collaborations are designed according to each brand's goals, audience and budget.

items.question: How can I tell if the campaigns are working?
items.answer:
We set performance indicators according to the goals of each strategy.

Depending on the service, we analyze metrics such as reach, engagement, traffic, leads, conversions and attributable business results.

We share reports that help you understand how the actions performed and identify opportunities for improvement.

items.question: What if my brand already has active social media accounts or campaigns?
items.answer:
We can work with existing accounts.

We start by reviewing your current situation to identify what's working, what can be improved and what opportunities we can take advantage of.

Starting from scratch isn't always necessary. In many cases, a well-focused strategy can help optimize existing efforts.

items.question: Can you work with my in-house marketing team?
items.answer:
Of course.

We can complement your team's work with specific strategy, design, content production, advertising or consulting services.

We adapt to each company's structure to build an efficient collaboration.

items.question: Do you work with brands outside Mexico City?
items.answer:
Yes. Although our studio is based in Mexico City, we collaborate with companies from different cities and countries.

Our methodology lets us develop strategies and manage projects remotely, keeping close communication and constant follow-up.

items.question: How much does it cost to build a website?
items.answer: Each project is quoted based on its features, number of sections and level of customization.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: Generally between 4 and 8 weeks, depending on complexity and the content available. Custom developments may take longer.

items.question: Will I be able to manage my site?

items.question: Can you redesign my current website?

items.question: Will my website work on mobile phones?

items.question: Do you include domain and hosting?

items.question: Do you offer maintenance?
items.answer: Yes. We include one month of initial support within the contracted scope and offer additional maintenance plans.

items.question: How many changes can I request?

intro.title: Four disciplines. One studio.
intro.subtitle: Specialists in every discipline. One creative ambition.
intro.p1: Pigmento is an independent creative studio based in Mexico City. We bring together branding, digital design, motion and marketing to build brands from strategy to public expression.
intro.p2: More than eleven years of practice have taught us to look at every project from different angles. We combine the depth of four specialties with the clarity of a shared creative direction.
intro.p3: Our work spans identities, packaging, digital experiences and campaigns. We build systems that give brands a recognisable voice and the ability to evolve without losing their character.
intro.p4: We work closely with our clients and defend ideas with arguments. We are driven by curiosity, rigour and the ambition to make work that deserves to exist.
